name: TNA World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The fed's top belt. Christian Cage is its champion from the inaugural weeks, in the fed's news of 10 February 2008 ('Christian Cage's championship gold') and on its cards of 13 July and 10 August 2008, where Tomko stands at his side; Hard Justice (10 August 2008) has him keep it against Sting in a Last Man Standing match. 1 reign is filed, each from a page that bills its holder or, where marked, from the fed's champions page.

name: TNA X Division Championship
epitaph: Named on the Victory Road card of 13 July 2008 and on Hard Justice, where, vacant, it is decided in a four-man gauntlet that Jeff Hardy wins. Two earlier holders are known from the fed's champions page only, by the file names of its portrait images. 3 reigns are filed, each from a page that bills its holder or, where marked, from the fed's champions page.

name: TNA Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Billed as 'Robert Roode Inc. (c)' against the Motor City Machine Guns on the Against All Odds card; the fed's champions page then shows Alex Shelley and Chris Sabin, and by 22 July 2008 the New D-X, Big Show and Rikishi, who keep it at Hard Justice in a steel cage three-way. 3 reigns are filed, each from a page that bills its holder or, where marked, from the fed's champions page.

name: TNA Women's Knockout Championship
epitaph: Named on the Against All Odds card (a #1 contenders match), in the news of 17 July 2008 (Karen Angle against Kelly Kelly for it) and at Hard Justice, where, vacant, it is decided in a three-way that Angelina Love and Velvet Skye win together as the Beautiful People. 3 reigns are filed, each from a page that bills its holder or, where marked, from the fed's champions page.
